name: open-desktop-pet-tauri
description: A tiny open-source desktop companion powered by Tauri 2.

scripts.check: npm run build && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.dist:win:gnu: "%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin\rustup.exe" run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cmd /c tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --bundles nsis
